items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I think I remember that.

ctx.x: Remember when Tyree Glenn had the broken leg on the road with Duke, and he was out there playing the vibes with his leg in a cast -- I think it was about 1950 or so.
Yeah, I think I remember that.

And in the band they said -- I don't know whether it was a joke or whether it was true, but they said the way Tyree broke his leg was that they were back east in Buffalo or somewhere and the streets were icy and Hibbler was about to go across the street by himself and Tyree was worried about him, and so he ran out to help Hibbler across the icy street and in the middle of the street Tyree fell down and broke his leg and Hibbler went right on across the street.
